name: Ryan Breslow
person: Ryan Breslow, founder of Bolt (one-click checkout, founded 2014), stepped down as CEO in Jan 2022 amid controversy, returned as CEO in March 2025. Also founded/backed Love, Bolt Ventures, and various crypto/wellness ventures. NOT any other Ryan Breslow.

enumPrompts.label: ensaios-talks
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate PRIMARY content from {{PERSON}} beyond what's already known, the current dossier baseline is heavy on CRITIQUE/press coverage of the 2022 controversy, SEC probe, and 2025 comeback, but likely THIN on his own primary voice/essays/talks. Prioritize finding his own words.
1. Walk his X/Twitter (@ryanbreslow) beyond the one known "Mob Bosses" thread, find other long-form threads where he lays out a business philosophy, founder advice, or his own account of the Bolt saga (departure, SEC probe resolution, 2025 return).
2. Find any blog posts, Medium essays, or LinkedIn posts he's authored directly (not press coverage about him), on checkout/ecommerce, on crypto (he's been vocal on crypto/wellness ventures), or on his return-to-CEO thesis.
3. Any podcast where HE is the guest doing extended first-person talking, beyond the two already cited (Logan Bartlett, My First Million), look for 2024-2026 appearances discussing the comeback specifically.
Return exact URLs, priority=high for anything with substantial first-person content, one-line "why" per item.
